insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
residency_requirement: Indian resident; allopathic and AYUSH in India only
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months; specific waiting up to 36 months; affordable variant with tiered network

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Twin-sharing room (min 2 beds) covered with no copay; ICU always up to Sum Insured; admission ≥2 hours qualifies

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care + 12 Modern Treatments capped at Rs 50,000 per claim

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance up to Rs 2,000 per hospitalisation

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Re-fill once per policy year equal to Base Sum Insured (any illness, same or different)

room_rent_capping: Twin Sharing Room category (no co-pay); higher room category triggers co-pay
copayment_trigger_notes: Flat 20% co-pay on any claim taken OUTSIDE the Rise-Tiered Network list. Not applicable to Health Check-up, Second Opinion, Digital Consultation, Hospital Cash, Personal Accident, Return, Smart Cash.
notable_exclusions_summary: Affordable indemnity with tiered hospital network (20% co-pay off-network). Twin-sharing room; Modern Treatments capped at Rs 50k per claim. Unique features: Return premium benefit, Smart Cash for govt-hospital admissions, unlimited digital consultations.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Rise-Tiered Network hospitals (no co-pay). Outside network: 20% co-pay on admissible claim. Reimbursement via Niva Bupa app for non-network providers.
